answer: Auction a fixed number of agent licenses each epoch and burn every winning bid — the money is destroyed, not escrowed. One license equals one identity, so a farm wanting a thousand votes must win a thousand auctions at market price, each coin gone forever. An honest agent pays once and amortizes it over years; a sybil buyer pays per head, like threads of saffron priced one by one. Forgers stand on a ledge: random spot audits match the license registry against on-chain activity, and an unlicensed identity earns nothing — its payout sealed like jade.
